_comment: Authoritative inputs for the per-building financial cutover. Loaded by backend/scripts/rollout_east_gate_financial_cutover.py via --seed-inputs. The file is upserted into core.building_settings (key: financial.cutover.authoritative_inputs) and never read again from disk after seeding. Real values must NEVER be committed to source control — copy this template, fill it in, run --seed-inputs, then delete the populated file (or store it in your secrets manager).
